newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-HAESSLER OUT FOR SEVERAL MONTHS AFTER INJURY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HAESSLER OUT FOR SEVERAL MONTHS AFTER INJURY.

text.p: Karlsruhe midfielder Thomas Haessler could be out of action for three months after breaking an ankle and tearing ligaments in his side's 2-0 win over Fortuna Duesseldorf on Friday night.
Haessler sustained the damage after a Duesseldorf player fell awkwardly on his left ankle. The Karlsruhe club doctor performed an overnight operation on the 30-year old player.
Karlsruhe said Haessler would be out at least until the end of the Bundesliga's winter break, which lasts from December to mid-February.
The news was a big blow for Germany coach Berti Vogts as Haessler, who has been in brilliant form for club and country, will now miss an important World Cup qualifier away to Portugal in December.
